sentence: Kirkle Back before you loreain what nobody asked to hear.

wombos.definition: To circle back on something with Kirk energy — returning to a topic or moment in a cool, composed manner.
wombos.example: Let me Kirkle Back to what I said earlier, because I think it matters.

wombos.definition: To over-explain the backstory, mythology, or concept behind something. Used as a verb: 'let me loreain this,' 'stop loreaining me,' 'she loreained the whole thing.'
